title: When Does Demographic Information Help? Data and Modeling Regimes for Perspective-Aware Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether models learn meaningful demographic signals or merely rely on global demographic priors (stereotypes) by comparing within-comment predictive accuracy using real versus shuffled annotator demographic profiles.

Measuring annotator disagreement in subjective hate speech and offensiveness annotations, and training a gated demographic residual model to capture how annotator identities and backgrounds shape variations in subjective judgments.

Analyzing data split properties to demonstrate how collapsing multiple annotator perspectives into a single majority-vote label introduces bias by obscuring meaningful disagreement and ambiguity in subjective tasks.
